title: Light Gratitude
intro: Work-friendly prompts for noticing what is going well. Keep it light.

prompts.text: What is one thing about your workspace that you appreciate?
What tool, shortcut or setting made something easier today?
What is a small comfort nearby, like good light or a favourite mug?
What is something that worked on the first try?
What is a moment of quiet you enjoyed lately?
What is something that just worked today, so you did not have to think about it?
What is one thing you are glad is finished?
What is something to look forward to, however small?
